$comment: REQ-HUN-008/009, DL-011. Potential is composite (§17): a legendary hunter is not simply the one with the biggest numbers. Tier is derived from the whole facet set, not from a single scalar.

facets.$comment: Each facet rolls independently. attributeCeiling raises the useful cap of attribute growth; growthRate affects points gained; affinity biases which build the hunter grows into naturally.

traitSlots.$comment: Number of innate traits. More traits means more identity, not necessarily more power.

tiers.$comment: Tier is assigned by a composite score over all facets plus trait count plus unique-skill presence. Thresholds are placeholders pending recruitment-feel testing (Phase 3).
